name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.37.2 — consultant discovery: the genesis interview stops being a scripted lens-batch script and becomes adaptive (specs/20260825/02-genesis-consultant-discovery.md). The one fixed structure is a silent **coverage audit** over ten business/legal/product keys the model cannot derive (`payer`, `tenancy`, `data-sensitivity`, `residency`, `ai-use`, `unattended`, `integrations`, `scale-outage`, `vendor-budget`, `offline-mobile`), recorded in `.claude/genesis/brief.md`'s `## Coverage` block and asked in plain language wherever dark; the hard-to-reverse dimension set now also derives six keys from those answers (`tenancy-model`, `data-residency`, `llm-provider`/`vector-store`/`eval-harness`, `data-in-training`, `background-jobs`, `observability`, `api-versioning`) on top of the archetype registry floor. **The brief is the interface**: authored from the new `spec/templates/genesis-brief.md` (six fixed sections), re-rendered and printed to the console after every answer — the old read-back sign-off gate is gone. A throwaway `.claude/genesis/sketch.html` checks understanding as soon as a core screen is named, pruned at `/spec:genesis-design` lock. Every `wf-research` menu option now carries `because` (the coverage answers behind its rank) and `priced` (a consequence at the brief's stated scale) as required schema fields; `genesis-architect.md` and `genesis-design.md` build every `AskUserQuestion` description from `tradeoff` · `because` · `priced` · recency. 7.37.1 — review-fix on specs/20260825/01: the retired genesis panel's last references are cleared from the one workflow that survived (`wf-research.js`'s `meta.description` and its dissent-flag comment) and from `genesis.md` § Genesis: Executed Assumptions. The AC-20260825-01-2 literal ban gains bare `panel` and extends its sweep to `wf-research.js`, closing the blind spot that let these through — `pipelineOwnedPaths` (`spec/workflows/wf-*.js`) prunes that file from collision-closure's literals leg and scope-reconcile alike, so the enumerated-file test is the only gate that can see it. 7.37.0 — Gotchas cap becomes a driver-enforced ratchet, never a CLOSE-step sentence: `prose-cap.js --baseline N` admits an over-cap section iff strictly smaller than N; the review driver records the verdict-time count on the review row (`gotchas`), prints it in the CLOSE step, and refuses `--mark closed` while an over-cap section has not shrunk (hosts without a pipelineRules file are skipped, row unchanged). Fixes the flag-day adoption gate measured at Upwell (138/15) and Prax (169/15, closed 2026-08-25 with the cap unmet by founder ruling); bulk pruning stays direct host work. review.md/escape.md name the ratchet.
